changes.description: The GNU libc libraries
changes.note:
Auto-sync with upstream branch release/2.43/master

Upstream commit: 9cda6fc96abd035d9cbe68482138d4a78a51a7d5

- stdlib: Don't call clearenv from __libc_setenv_freemem (Mark Wielaard)
- resolv: Fix assertion failure on search list truncation [BZ 31026, CVE-2026-8674] (Adhemerval Zanella)
- zic: keep needed last transition to new type (bug 34618) (Paul Eggert)
- nptl: Skip pretty-printer tests without python3 [BZ #34507] (Hemanth Kumar M D)
- hesiod: use booleans in parser macro calls (Adhemerval Zanella)
- hesiod: fix swapped arguments in service parser (Adhemerval Zanella)
- nss_files: use booleans in parser macro calls (Andreas Schwab)
- nss_files: fix swapped arguments in service parser (Andreas Schwab)
- libio: Add test for fopen with an empty ", ccs=" value [BZ #34574] (Shamil Abdulaev)
- libio: Fix CVE-2026-18374 heap buffer overflow in ccs= handling (Dongkyun Son)
- alpha: expect test-float32x-float64-div to fail (Matt Turner)
- alpha: add the denormal trap enable bit to FE_NOMASK_ENV (Matt Turner)
- alpha: Fix stack alignment in makecontext (Magnus Lindholm)
- alpha: fix setrlimit compat symbol for negative rlim values besides -1 (Matt Turner)
- iconvdata: Test case for bug 34556, bug 34568 (Florian Weimer)
- iconvdata: EUC_JISX0213 decoding lacks pending character reset (CVE-2026-80489) (Florian Weimer)
- iconvdata: SHIFT_JISX0213 decoding lacks pending character reset (CVE-2026-77117) (Florian Weimer)
- stdlib: Fix right-justification in strfmon (bug 34510, CVE-2026-19499) (Florian Weimer)
- posix: Remove unnecessary overflow check in wordexp (BZ 34090) (Adhemerval Zanella)
- m68k: remove sysdeps/m68k/m680x0/fpu/w_fmod_compat.c (bug 34559) (Andreas Schwab)
- misc: Fix out-of-bounds array write in tdelete (bug 34506) (Florian Weimer)
- malloc: Show hugetlb tunable default in --list-tunables (Wilco Dijkstra)
- m68k: Fix fmod/fmodf infinite recursion (BZ 34508) (Adhemerval Zanella)
- posix: Fix wordexp WRDE_APPEND to preserve state on non-NOSPACE errors (BZ 34090, CVE-2026-6368) (Adhemerval Zanella)

changes.description: Repodata downloading library
changes.note:
* downloader: don't rescan every target when nothing can be started
* handle: Validate the new value of LRO_MAXMIRRORTRIES
* downloader: hold transfer state per connection, not per target 
* xmlparser: Check the parser context before using it
* util: Handle partial writes in lr_copy_content()
* repoutil_yum: Use S_ISDIR() to check for a directory
* mirrorlist: Close the duplicated descriptor if fdopen() fails
* package_downloader: Restore the SIGINT handler on all return paths
* Fix leaks of zchunk contexts on error paths
* checksum: Fix a memory leak and an out-of-bounds read
* Don't pass negative values to ctype functions
* downloader: Accept file descriptor 0 in lr_download()
* repomd: Fix a warning message and a memory leak
* Fix swapped function arguments
* metadata_downloader: Don't use error messages as format strings
* downloader: Compare HTTP header names case-insensitively

changes.description: Netscape Portable Runtime
Network Security Services
changes.note:
NSS Release Notes

Update NSS to 3.130.0

- Bug 1951159 -  release the decoded certificate when CERT_NewTempCertificate fails.
- Bug 2012680 - Testcases for DER_GetInteger error handling.
- Bug 2019001 - Update policy for mlkem1024 named group and others.
- Bug 2028690 - Keep the default input size limit in NSS_CMSMessage_CreateFromDER.
- Bug 2030245 - Add Windows ARM64 build support to NSS.
- Bug 2047359 - propagate the PKCS#12 max element length to nested decoders.
- Bug 2054712 - Don't accept post-handshake CertificateRequest in DTLS.
- Bug 2061391 - perform session object removals under slot lock.
- Bug 2064306 - avoid VLA in tls_ech_unittest.cc.
- Bug 2064311 - Remove HPKE internals from public headers.
- Bug 2064502 - add tsan build for NSS in treeherder.
- Bug 2068001 - Switch NSS to WIN95 target and remove Windows fiber code.
- Bug 2070118 - Change the error from decode_error to illegal_parameter for the case when update field in Key Update is neither update_requested nor update_not_requested.
- Bug 2070421 - Set _NSPR_BUILD_ for Windows builds.
- Bug 2070669 - NSS release process improvements.
- Bug 2072042 - selfserv: drain connections before closing.
- Bug 2072384 - remove unnecessary certs dependencies in CI graph.
- Bug 2072389 - fix uninitialized SECItem.type in SECKEY_ConvertToPublicKey.
- Bug 2072396 - reduce core file detection frequency in CI runs.
- Bug 2072554 - add missing return in do_key_slot when no internal key slot.
- Bug 2072633 - return CKR_HOST_MEMORY when PORT_NewArena fails in jpakesftk.c.
- Bug 2072682 - initialize referenceCount in crlutil's CRL allocations.
- Bug 2073728 - remove some unused types and functions from lib/pki.
- Bug 2074429 - applied clang-format on nss.
- Bug 2074515 - Include blapit.h to expose AES_BLOCK_SIZE and SHA_*_LENGTH.

https://firefox-source-docs.mozilla.org/security/nss/releases/nss_3_130.html
